parameters.query: select f.id, f.canonical_url, f.title, f.summary, f.angle, f.relevance, f.specificity, f.angle_strength, f.score, f.tags, f.created_at, f.published_at, f.structured, 1 as articles, case when f.published_at is null then null else greatest(0, extract(day from now() - f.published_at)::int) end as age_days from feed_items f where nullif($7,'') is null and (nullif($1,'') is null or coalesce(f.published_at, f.created_at) >= nullif($1,'')::timestamptz) and (nullif($2,'') is null or f.relevance >= nullif($2,'')::int) and (nullif($3,'') is null or lower(nullif($3,'')) = any(f.tags)) and (nullif($5,'') is null or f.score >= nullif($5,'')::int) and (nullif($6,'') is null or coalesce(f.published_at, f.created_at) >= now() - (nullif($6,'')::int * interval '1 day')) union all select null::bigint as id, s.canonical_url, s.title, s.summary, s.angle, null::int as relevance, s.specificity, s.angle_strength, s.score, s.tags, s.created_at, s.last_published as published_at, s.structured, s.articles, case when s.last_published is null then null else greatest(0, extract(day from now() - s.last_published)::int) end as age_days from feed_stories s where nullif($7,'') is not null and (nullif($1,'') is null or coalesce(s.last_published, s.created_at) >= nullif($1,'')::timestamptz) and (nullif($3,'') is null or lower(nullif($3,'')) = any(s.tags)) and (nullif($5,'') is null or s.score >= nullif($5,'')::int) and (nullif($6,'') is null or coalesce(s.last_published, s.created_at) >= now() - (nullif($6,'')::int * interval '1 day')) order by score desc nulls last, published_at desc limit coalesce(nullif($4,'')::int, 20)
